messages.subject: [SOONY-A0343435B3] Conditional hold for CMP-GAM-008
messages.body:
Hello Karton Nowak team,

Regarding CMP-GAM-008:
If your earlier price of 2.1 EUR per unit and free hold are still available, please reserve up to 5,900 units without charge. Please confirm the quantity held, hold expiry and unit price in writing. Please quote partial delivery, freight surcharge and handover time separately for review.

Any dispatch, booking or cost requires separate written authorization.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-A0343435B3] Conditional hold for CMP-GAM-008
messages.body:
Dzień dobry,

We can propose to reserve up to 5,900 finished CMP-GAM-008 art books from our available stock at EUR 2.10 per unit, subject to formal written confirmation. I need to check internally how long we can hold this quantity without charge and the separate terms for any partial delivery or freight.

No dispatch, transport booking or cost will be initiated without Soony’s separate written authorization.

Pozdrawiam serdecznie,
Agnieszka Nowak
Karton Nowak Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-A0343435B3] Conditional hold for CMP-GAM-008
messages.body:
Hello,

Could you provide a firm written quote for CMP-GAM-008? We still need available quantity, delivery date and time at the receiving site.

Please restate the complete offer for the same lot in one reply: Quantity (units), Unit price (currency per unit), Delivery (YYYY-MM-DD, time and zone), and quote expiry. Itemize any freight charge separately. If the requested window is unavailable, quote the earliest feasible partial delivery.

This is a request for information only.
